use_case_name: Check Files for Duplicates and Corruption

claims.content: User
The user has accessed the file management utilities from the initial window of the application (file manager interface), create archive window, or extraction window.
Files have been selected by the user for which duplicate checking or corruption verification is to be performed.
An original checksum or hash value is known for the files being checked for corruption.
The user accesses the 'Tools' menu from the initial window of the application (file manager interface).
The system displays a submenu with choices including 'System tools' and 'System benchmark'.
The user selects an option under 'System tools' such as 'Disk cleanup', 'Disk defrag', or 'Disk management' to manage files.
Alternatively, the user may access file selection options via the 'Edit' button in the file manager interface to select objects for processing.
The system has executed the selected system tool or benchmark utility to process the files.
If a benchmark was run, the system has displayed the results of the system performance test.
The user remains in the file manager interface or the specific tool interface upon completion of the operation.
